page_title: WHU 0-6 ARS | West Ham v Arsenal 11/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+1' Today's referee Craig Pawson rightly decides to book Kalvin Phillips (West Ham) for his harsh tackle.
90+1' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
88' Craig Pawson has a clear sight and sees a foul from Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham).
85' Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal) commits a rough challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.

83' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. David Raya guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
82' Mohamed Elneny (Arsenal) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
82' West Ham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
79' It looks like Kalvin Phillips (West Ham) saw red with that tackle. Craig Pawson won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
77' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Gabriel Martinelli walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal).
77' Here is a change. Ben White is going off and Mikel Arteta gives the last tactical orders to Cedric (Arsenal).
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Emerson trots off the pitch and is replaced by Aaron Cresswell (West Ham).
76' The foul by Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Craig Pawson.
74' Alphonse Areola pulls off a great save to deny Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.

72' Mohamed Elneny (Arsenal) wastes an opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires in a terrific shot from long range towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
70' Craig Pawson couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Gabriel (Arsenal) and blew his whistle.
67' A substitution has been made. Leandro Trossard goes off and Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) comes on.
67' Mikel Arteta has decided to make a change. Reiss Nelson (Arsenal) replaces Bukayo Saka.
67' Mohamed Elneny (Arsenal) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Declan Rice.
65' 0 - 6 What an absolute cracking goal! Declan Rice (Arsenal) hits a perfect volley from far out and the ball flies inside the left post. Take a bow.
63' 0 - 5 Goal! Martin Odegaard shows great vision to find Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the right side of the goal. 0:5.
61' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Kalvin Phillips (West Ham). Craig Pawson saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
58' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Alphonse Areola is alert and denies him with a nice save.
56' The current number of shots on goal is 0:7.
53' Benjamin Johnson (West Ham) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
50' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.

49' A lofted pass evades the keeper and lands right on the head of Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) in the centre of the box, but his header sails narrowly wide of the right post when an empty net was beckoning.
49' Ben White (Arsenal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
47' A clever short pass gives Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Kurt Zouma is replaced by Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham).
46' David Moyes has made a change at the break. Kalvin Phillips has come on in place of Edson Alvarez (West Ham).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+8' The end of the first half.
45+6' Flag up against Ben White (Arsenal). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
45+5' Arsenal control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
45+2' 0 - 4 Goal! Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) takes a short pass from Martin Odegaard in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the top right corner. 0:4.
45+2' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
44' 0 - 3 The ball is whipped in from the resulting set piece and finds Gabriel (Arsenal), who rises and produces a crashing header low into the middle of the net.

44' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Craig Pawson blows his whistle for an infringement. Arsenal will take a free kick near the side line.
41' 0 - 2 Goal! Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Alphonse Areola to commit before slotting the penalty into the right of the goal.
41' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is going to take the penalty!
40' Referee Craig Pawson is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Arsenal!
39' Celebrations by Arsenal are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
38' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Alphonse Areola (West Ham), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
38' Alphonse Areola (West Ham) brings his opponent down. Craig Pawson has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Arsenal are awarded a penalty!

37' Golden opportunity! Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
36' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the left post!
35' Ben White (Arsenal) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
32' 0 - 1 William Saliba (Arsenal) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header into the roof of the net from close range. The score is 0:1.
32' Declan Rice (Arsenal) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
32' Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Arsenal.
30' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
29' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) makes a rough challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Declan Rice (Arsenal) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
28' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Arsenal are going to take it.
25' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post.
25' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

24' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) meets a cross inside the penalty area and unloads a good attempt towards the top of the net. Alphonse Areola is prepared, though, and denies him with a fantastic save. Arsenal win a corner.
23' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) meets a cross inside the box and heads it goalwards. Unfortunately for him, he sends the ball narrowly over the crossbar. What a chance!
22' Kurt Zouma (West Ham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

20' Great solo effort by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save.
19' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) receives a pass then lets rip from long range towards the left of the goal, but David Raya watches it all the way and makes an easy save.
18' West Ham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
17' Benjamin Johnson (West Ham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. West Ham will have a chance to score from a corner.
15' The West Ham players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
12' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
12' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Arsenal will take a corner kick.
12' Declan Rice (Arsenal) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
12' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Arsenal have a corner.
11' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) wins a header inside the box after a cross and steers it goalwards, but Alphonse Areola produces a wonderful reflex save.
9' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Craig Pawson had an easy-decision to make.
9' Gabriel (Arsenal) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
9' There's an opportunity for Declan Rice (Arsenal) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

8' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Arsenal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
7' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
5' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
3' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is adjudged offside.
2' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
2' The Arsenal players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Arsenal will have the kick-off.
Craig Pawson is introduced as the referee for today's match.
